name: Scan Me
summary: A shop share card that draws a real, scannable QR code dot by dot, scans it and saves it as a PNG
about: A bakery share card with a real QR code made right in the page, for any link or text you type. Press Make code and the old dots shiver and fall, the new ones fly in from the middle with a springy overshoot, a lime scan line reads it and a phone rises to lock on and show the link. Change the dot style or colour and a wave sweeps across the code; Save PNG gives you a print-ready file.
how: Type a link or any text (up to 151 bytes); the plate blurs until you press Make code or Enter.
Watch the dots fly in, the finder squares spin into place and the logo badge pop in the middle.
A scan line sweeps down, the corners lock on with a tick, and a phone rises to read the code.
Pick Square, Round or Soft dots and one of five colours; a wave restyles the code in place.
Copy link puts the link on your clipboard and Save PNG downloads a 1024 px image with a white border.
